title: Abilities Registry: overview film
description: Decide what AI agents may do in TYPO3. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 47 seconds: Abilities Registry for TYPO3 v14. Everything the site can do; People approve risky actions; Every attempt on record. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: MCP, REST, webhooks and the CLI each get their own checks, and nobody can say which agent did what.
The Abilities Registry describes each action once, with its scopes and its risk.
One catalogue lists everything the site can do, and how to call it on every surface.
High-risk abilities need a person’s approval. Tokens and agents can never approve.
Every attempt is traced, denials included.
Abilities Registry. A trace for every attempt.
